svg.title: EP2 C2 AREA 13
svg.desc: Spaceship uses parallel spawn routes. Each group handles its own mechanisms and regroups as soon as the gate opens. The two groups split up and regroup in room 2, where the barrier drops once they warp in. Save Moon Atomizers and recovery items for the boss. Room 8 needs no clearing; go straight east. Avoid the enemies in the hallway east of room 9, then clear room 10 and head southeast to the boss. The south start group goes west through 1b and 1c into warp A, avoiding the hallway enemies. The north start group goes east to 1e, north to 1f, then east into warp B, avoiding the hallway enemies. Back in room 2, ignore enemies where possible, press the switch and take the centre warp C. In room 3 take the northeast warp D; in room 4 take the southwest warp E. Room 5 is a poison room with the antidote switch behind the north barrier. Watch for jumping Delsabers, clear the room and go east.
